# Source artifacts and support decisions

| Artifact | Decision / owner | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Container/mutex/iterator/worker/loop source | Adapt as lifecycle procedure and explicit-record auditor | Not a task scheduler/state-machine/GPU simulator; observations remain declarations |
| GatedDelta MSL/host gate and selected callers/tests | Adapt as recurrent-contract procedure and metadata screener | No numerical recurrence/selector/device implementation copied |
| Source model-loading, downloader, CLI or broad test examples | Reference-only / unselected | May fetch weights, require native packages/credentials or broader resource authority |
| Native Xcode test commands | External reports only | Original fixtures/toolchain are unbundled, not checkout dependencies of runtime graph |
| CI installation/DerivedData deletion/integration scripts | Unselected | Host mutation, dependencies and model downloads outside authorized source slice |
